exercises.instruction: Посмотрите на картинки и напишите вопросы с How long … ?

answers: How long does it take by plane from London to Amsterdam?
How long does it take by car from Milan to Rome?
How long does it take by train from Paris to Geneva?
How long does it take by bus from the city centre to the airport?

exercises.instruction: Сколько времени это занимает? Напишите полные предложения.

items.prompt: fly from your city/country to London
modelAnswers: It takes two hours to fly from Stuttgart to London.

items.prompt: fly from your city/country to New York
modelAnswers: It takes ... hours to fly from ... to New York.

items.prompt: study to be a doctor in your country
modelAnswers: It takes ... years to study to be a doctor in ....

items.prompt: walk from your home to the nearest shop
modelAnswers: It takes ... to walk from my home to the nearest shop.

items.prompt: get from your home to the nearest airport
modelAnswers: It takes ... to get from my home to the nearest airport.

exercises.instruction: Напишите вопросы с How long did it take … ?

items.prompt: (Jane found a job.)
answers: How long did it take her to find a job?

items.prompt: (I walked to the station.)
answers: How long did it take you to walk to the station?

items.prompt: (Tom painted the bathroom.)
answers: How long did it take him to paint the bathroom?

items.prompt: (I learnt to ski.)
answers: How long did it take you to learn to ski?

items.prompt: (They repaired the car.)
answers: How long did it take them to repair the car?

exercises.instruction: Прочитайте описания ситуаций и напишите предложения с It took … .

items.prompt: I read a book last week. I started reading it on Monday. I finished it three days later.
answers: It took me three days to read the book.

items.prompt: We walked home last night. We left at 10 o’clock and we arrived home at 10.20.
answers: It took us 20 minutes to walk home.
It took us 20 minutes to get home.

items.prompt: I learnt to drive last year. I had my first driving lesson in January. I passed my driving test six months later.
answers: It took me six months to learn to drive.

items.prompt: Mark drove to London yesterday. He left home at 7 o’clock and got to London at 10.
answers: It took Mark three hours to drive to London.
It took him three hours to drive to London.
It took Mark three hours to get to London.
It took him three hours to get to London.

items.prompt: Lisa began looking for a job a long time ago. She got a job last week.
answers: It took Lisa a long time to find a job.
It took her a long time to find a job.
It took Lisa a long time to get a job.
It took her a long time to get a job.

items.prompt: Напишите предложение о себе.
answers: It took me ... to ...

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык. (обучение (здесь) = study, сделать ремонт (здесь) = decorate, стоянка машин = car park)

items.prompt: Сколько времени занимает перелёт из Москвы до Лондона?
answers: How long does it take to fly from Moscow to London?

items.prompt: Саше потребовалось два месяца, чтобы найти новую работу.
answers: It took Sasha two months to find a new job.

items.prompt: Обучение в университете занимает три года.
answers: It takes three years to study at university.

items.prompt: Поездка на машине от моей квартиры до офиса занимает один час.
answers: It takes an hour by car from my flat to the office.
It takes an hour by car from my flat to my office.

items.prompt: Нам потребуется три недели, чтобы сделать ремонт гостиной.
answers: It will take us three weeks to decorate the living room.

items.prompt: Приготовление обеда не займёт много времени.
answers: It won’t take long to make lunch.
It won’t take long to cook lunch.
It won’t take long to prepare lunch.
It won’t take a long time to make lunch.
It won’t take a long time to cook lunch.
It won’t take a long time to prepare lunch.

items.prompt: Вы долго искали стоянку машин?
answers: Did it take you a long time to find the car park?
Did it take you long to find the car park?

items.prompt: Сколько времени вам потребовалось, чтобы написать книгу?
answers: How long did it take you to write the book?
How long did it take you to write your book?
